{
 "cells": [
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "defab686",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "# Wedge\n",
    "This notebook cover the mapting of a wedge with its internal angle $\\alpha$ into the half-plane."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "0df4d34e",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## The mapping\n",
    "Th emapping of a wedge to a  helf-plaine is given by\n",
    "\\begin{equation*}\n",
    "    z = \\mathrm{e}^{\\mathrm{i}\\alpha}\n",
    "\\end{equation*}"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 10,
   "id": "a4b3793c",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "from conformal_mappings.mappings import z_to_xi_wedge, xi_to_z_wedge\n",
    "from conformal_mappings.elements import omega_uni_flow\n",
    "from conformal_mappings.plotter import contour_flow_net"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "14b2e571",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Uniform flow along the wedge\n",
    "We consider the case of uniform flow along the boundary of the wedge."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 11,
   "id": "d5b4db1e",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "# Varialbes\n",
    "w = 1 + 0j\n",
    "alpha = np.pi/6\n",
    "\n",
    "# Omega function\n",
    "omega_func = lambda z: omega_uni_flow(z, w)\n",
    "\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 12,
   "id": "6adc39ba",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 1500x700 with 2 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(15, 7))\n",
    "contour_flow_net(\n",
    "    (-50, 50),\n",
    "    (0, 50),\n",
    "    flow_func= omega_func,\n",
    "    levels=50,\n",
    "    xgrid_points=400,\n",
    "    ygrid_points=400,\n",
    "    mapping_func=lambda chi: xi_to_z_wedge(chi, alpha),\n",
    "    ax=ax[0]\n",
    ")\n",
    "xi = np.concatenate([\n",
    "    np.linspace(-80, -1e-3, 20),\n",
    "    np.linspace(-1e-8, 1e-8, 15),\n",
    "    np.linspace(1e-3, 80, 15)\n",
    "]) + 0j\n",
    "z = xi_to_z_wedge(xi, alpha)\n",
    "z[0] = -1 + z[0].imag*1.1j\n",
    "ax[0].fill_between(z.real, z.imag, y2=-1, facecolor=(.8,.8,.8,1), edgecolor=\"k\", zorder=10)\n",
    "ax[0].set_xlim(0, 2)\n",
    "ax[0].set_ylim(0, 1)\n",
    "ax[0].set_title(\"z-plane\")\n",
    "ax[0].set_aspect('equal')\n",
    "\n",
    "contour_flow_net(\n",
    "    (-10,10),\n",
    "    (0, 10),\n",
    "    flow_func= omega_func,\n",
    "    levels=50,\n",
    "    xgrid_points=400,\n",
    "    ygrid_points=400,\n",
    "    mapping_func=None,\n",
    "    ax=ax[1]\n",
    ")\n",
    "ax[1].set_xlim(-10, 10)\n",
    "ax[1].set_ylim(0, 10)\n",
    "ax[1].set_title(\"chi-plane\")\n",
    "ax[1].set_aspect('equal')"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "3c6a3feb",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## A well near an impermeable wall\n",
    "We consider the case of a well near an impreamable wall along the boundary of the wedge."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 13,
   "id": "5ad3cd28",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 1500x700 with 2 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "# Varialbes\n",
    "from conformal_mappings.elements import omega_well\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "q = 1\n",
    "zw = 4 + 1j\n",
    "\n",
    "# Omega function\n",
    "omega_func = lambda z: omega_well(z, q, lambda z: z-zw) + omega_well(z, q, lambda z: z-np.conj(zw))\n",
    "\n",
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(15, 7))\n",
    "contour_flow_net(\n",
    "    (-50, 50),\n",
    "    (0, 50),\n",
    "    flow_func= omega_func,\n",
    "    levels=50,\n",
    "    xgrid_points=400,\n",
    "    ygrid_points=400,\n",
    "    mapping_func=lambda chi: xi_to_z_wedge(chi, alpha),\n",
    "    ax=ax[0]\n",
    ")\n",
    "xi = np.concatenate([\n",
    "    np.linspace(-80, -1e-3, 20),\n",
    "    np.linspace(-1e-8, 1e-8, 15),\n",
    "    np.linspace(1e-3, 80, 15)\n",
    "]) + 0j\n",
    "z = xi_to_z_wedge(xi, alpha)\n",
    "z[0] = -1 + z[0].imag*1.1j\n",
    "ax[0].fill_between(z.real, z.imag, y2=-1, facecolor=(.8,.8,.8,1), edgecolor=\"k\", zorder=10)\n",
    "ax[0].set_xlim(0, 2)\n",
    "ax[0].set_ylim(0, 1)\n",
    "ax[0].set_title(\"z-plane\")\n",
    "ax[0].set_aspect('equal')\n",
    "\n",
    "contour_flow_net(\n",
    "    (-10,10),\n",
    "    (0, 10),\n",
    "    flow_func= omega_func,\n",
    "    levels=50,\n",
    "    xgrid_points=400,\n",
    "    ygrid_points=400,\n",
    "    mapping_func=None,\n",
    "    ax=ax[1]\n",
    ")\n",
    "ax[1].set_xlim(-10, 10)\n",
    "ax[1].set_ylim(0, 10)\n",
    "ax[1].set_title(\"chi-plane\")\n",
    "ax[1].set_aspect('equal')"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "43acc1e7",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## A well near a smooth curved impermeable wall\n",
    "We can also make the wedge have a smooth tip by offsetting the mirror a small amount."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 14,
   "id": "84b6b19d",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 1500x700 with 2 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "zw = 4 + 1j\n",
    "\n",
    "# Omega function\n",
    "omega_func = lambda z: omega_well(z, q, lambda z: z-zw) + omega_well(z, q, lambda z: z-(np.conj(zw)+.01j))\n",
    "\n",
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(15, 7))\n",
    "contour_flow_net(\n",
    "    (-50, 50),\n",
    "    (0, 50),\n",
    "    flow_func= omega_func,\n",
    "    levels=50,\n",
    "    xgrid_points=400,\n",
    "    ygrid_points=400,\n",
    "    mapping_func=lambda chi: xi_to_z_wedge(chi, alpha),\n",
    "    ax=ax[0]\n",
    ")\n",
    "# Refine the mapped boundary near the origin while keeping the far-field coverage\n",
    "xi = np.concatenate([\n",
    "    np.linspace(-80, -5, 1500),\n",
    "    np.linspace(-5, -1e-3, 2000),\n",
    "    np.linspace(-1e-3, 1e-3, 1500),\n",
    "    np.linspace(1e-3, 5, 1500),\n",
    "    np.linspace(5, 80, 1500)\n",
    "]) + 0.01j\n",
    "z = xi_to_z_wedge(xi, alpha)\n",
    "z[0] = -1 + z[0].imag*1.1j\n",
    "ax[0].fill_between(z.real, z.imag, y2=-1, facecolor=(.8,.8,.8,1), edgecolor=\"k\", zorder=10)\n",
    "ax[0].set_xlim(0, 2)\n",
    "ax[0].set_ylim(0, 1)\n",
    "ax[0].set_title(\"z-plane\")\n",
    "ax[0].set_aspect('equal')\n",
    "\n",
    "contour_flow_net(\n",
    "    (-10,10),\n",
    "    (0, 10),\n",
    "    flow_func= omega_func,\n",
    "    levels=50,\n",
    "    xgrid_points=400,\n",
    "    ygrid_points=400,\n",
    "    mapping_func=None,\n",
    "    ax=ax[1]\n",
    ")\n",
    "ax[1].set_xlim(-10, 10)\n",
    "ax[1].set_ylim(0, 10)\n",
    "ax[1].set_title(\"chi-plane\")\n",
    "ax[1].set_aspect('equal')"
   ]
  }
 ],
